seoTitle: Services · Packaging sourcing, design and logistics · NOVERA
seoDescription: From specification to delivery: sourcing, design and logistics. A single partner for all your premium packaging.

hero.heading: Our services
hero.intro: End-to-end support, from defining the need to delivery. A single partner for your entire packaging.

items.title: Sourcing
items.description: We identify the right manufacturer for every specification, including formats and closures you won't find elsewhere. You consolidate suppliers and gain consistency.

items.title: Design
items.description: Technical sheets, proofs, customization, logo placement: we frame every detail before production, for a perfect result from the first batch.

items.title: Logistics
items.description: We manage transport, customs and delivery, with buffer stock and on-demand shipments available. You are always on time, without tying up cash.

items.title: Closures
items.description: Closures and stoppering systems, all types: bartops, screw caps, pourers, reducers.

items.title: Glass components
items.description: Bottles and flacons, standard or bespoke formats, in a wide range of colours and finishes.
items.imageAlt: Green glass bottle on a neutral background

items.title: Shrink capsules
items.description: Shrink PVC capsules and overcaps, for a clean finish.
items.imageAlt: Bronze capsule on the neck of a dark bottle

items.title: Decoration & customization
items.description: Screen printing, gilding, lacquering: we create bespoke products in your brand's image.

contact.description: A question, a brief, a quote request? Write to us — our team replies within 48 hours.
